exposure: Elective caesarean sections for placenta praevia
outcome: Duration of intensive care unit stay
cohort: 67 obstetric patients admitted to the Intensive Care Unit of Kwong Wah Hospital in Hong Kong from January 1, 2006 to December 31, 2010
finding: Postpartum haemorrhage and pregnancy-induced hypertension were the most common reasons for intensive care unit admission among obstetric patients, and while the use of elective caesarean section for placenta praevia increased, maternal mortality rates remained stable.
mod_finding: The study found an increasing trend of intensive care unit admissions following elective caesarean section for placenta praevia.
